277055|98eee030.name: Axle Smoothslice
277055|98eee030.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, reshape tusks and horns, and even modify undead features!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

3084|de5042ab.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|de5042ab.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

92871-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92871-accept.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

93736-progress.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-progress.text: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous place. Some even say it's haunted. I'm quite sure that I don't believe that, but I do know that it's not for the faint hearted, or the unprepared.
93736-progress.title: Unwelcome Spirits

94568-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568-accept.title: The Cult's True Plans

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
